page_title: EVE 1-3 MCI | Everton v Manchester City 27/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' It looks like Michael Keane (Everton) saw red with that tackle. John Brooks won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Phil Foden (Manchester City) has a sight of goal and shoots from distance, but Jordan Pickford is equal to it.
90+1' Phil Foden (Manchester City) picks up a rebound and fires in from mid-range, but the ball crashes against the right post!
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Amadou Onana (Everton) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Dominic Calvert-Lewin, but Ederson displays great awareness to stop him.

86' 1 - 3 GOAL! And it’s the keeper’s mistake after his poor pass is easily intercepted by Bernardo Silva (Manchester City), who gleefully finds the net from mid range with a first time effort. That makes it 1:3.
85' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) hits a good looking first-time shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly over the bar.
85' Ederson displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
81' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) has tested the patience of referee John Brooks and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
80' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Jack Harrison walks off the pitch to be replaced by Arnaut Danjuma (Everton).
80' James Tarkowski (Everton) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
78' Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
77' James Tarkowski (Everton) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and John Brooks blows for a foul.
75' Golden chance! Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post.
70' 5:20 – the total goal attempt statistics.
67' Everton can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
65' Substitution. Andre Gomes did his best and is replaced by Michael Keane (Everton).
65' Sean Dyche has decided to make a change. Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) replaces Beto.
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) will replace Matheus Nunes.
64' 1 - 2 Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) sends Jordan Pickford the wrong way and fires the penalty into the middle of the goal!
64' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
63' Jordan Pickford (Everton) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
62' The players claim that Amadou Onana (Everton) handled the ball and it seems they are right. A penalty is given to Manchester City!
61' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out of play. Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
61' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the left post only for Jordan Pickford to dive and make a save.
61' Manchester City work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
60' Andre Gomes (Everton) is booked after bringing down an opponent. John Brooks had an easy-decision to make.
59' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes a short corner kick.
59' John Brooks shows a yellow card to Manuel Akanji (Manchester City) for his blatant foul.

59' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
56' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
55' Phil Foden (Manchester City) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post.

53' 1 - 1 Phil Foden (Manchester City) scores an incredible goal! He receives a pass, makes some space for himself and unleashes a long-range thunderbolt of a shot past the goalkeeper into the bottom right corner.
53' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Bernardo Silva (Manchester City).
52' Jordan Pickford (Everton) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
51' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when John Brooks blows for a foul. Everton are awarded the free kick.
50' John Brooks blows his whistle. Amadou Onana (Everton) commits a foul after dangerous play.

49' Ambitious effort from Beto (Everton). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
48' Rodri (Manchester City) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
46' The whistle blows and John Brooks starts the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
45+3' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Manchester City.
45+2' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Rodri (Manchester City) commits a rough challenge and John Brooks blows his whistle for an infringement.
43' John Stones (Manchester City) is being substituted because of an injury. Pep Guardiola sends Josko Gvardiol on the pitch.
40' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
40' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Manchester City.
39' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nathan Patterson (Everton) was quite harsh and John Brooks didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
38' John Stones (Manchester City) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
37' John Stones (Manchester City) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
36' Beto (Everton) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
35' Beto (Everton) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
34' The corner kick from Andre Gomes (Everton) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

34' Ederson pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Jack Harrison (Everton) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the roof of the net, but was stopped by the goalkeeper. Everton win a corner.
33' Andre Gomes (Everton) takes the corner but it's cleared.
33' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out of play. Everton are awarded a corner kick.
32' A shot from the edge of the box by Rodri (Manchester City) is a waste and goes well wide of the right post.
32' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
29' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Dwight McNeil picks out Jack Harrison (Everton) with a sweet pass, and he latches on to it deep inside the box and beats the goalkeeper. 1:0.
28' Andre Gomes (Everton) commits a rough foul. John Brooks stops the game and makes a call.
27' A rebound falls kindly for Bernardo Silva (Manchester City), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
27' Ederson displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after James Tarkowski (Everton) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
26' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Dwight McNeil (Everton). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

24' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom left corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Jordan Pickford, who tips the ball around the post.
22' Amadou Onana (Everton) makes a strong challenge and John Brooks blows for a foul.
21' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 26:74.
19' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Andre Gomes (Everton), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
18' John Brooks blows for a foul after Kyle Walker (Manchester City) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Everton get a free kick.
16' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Manchester City comes to nothing.

15' Well-positioned Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Jordan Pickford reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop! The referee signals a corner kick to Manchester City.

15' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, Jordan Pickford anticipates the shot and makes an easy save.
13' Phil Foden (Manchester City) wins the ball in the box, but curls his effort high over the bar.
10' Andre Gomes (Everton) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
10' John Brooks has a clear sight and sees a foul from John Stones (Manchester City). Everton earn a free kick.
9' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

8' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) picks up a loose pass and unexpectedly unleashes a howitzer from distance, but the effort comes to nothing as a defender gets in the block. The referee blows his whistle, Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
8' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
7' James Garner (Everton) brings his opponent down with a tackle and John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Jordan Pickford is alert and denies him.
3' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
1' Beto (Everton) spurns a big chance! He makes himself some space to meet a cross and from near the penalty spot sends a header well wide of the left post!
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Everton will have the kick-off.
John Brooks was nominated as the referee for this game.
